dan: Heads up — planned power-handshake maintenance on EU rack P2 (colocation vendor) Tue 2026-04-12 02:00–04:00 UTC. We will perform staged power cycles on PDUs; expected effect: transient NIC flaps and GPU host reboots. Goal: avoid customer-visible downtime but expect some retries. Need ops runbook, live-migration checks, and customer comms.

eva: Ack. Which subpools are impacted? Any Dedicated pools pinned to these hosts?

dan: Affected: eu-west3-gpu-pool-b. Dedicated tenants on those hosts: tenant-dedicated-7. Plan is to attempt live-migrate containers to warm standbys before power cycles; fallback is fail-over to reserve capacity.

mike: Live migration depends on driver/kernel. Quick probe: ```./tools/check-lm.sh eu-west3-gpu-pool-b``` — will run now and post results.

sophie: If we need cross-region burst to us-east warm-standby, call out cost impact — rough estimate +20-30% on serving spend for the window. @natalie can you confirm we have budget buffer for emergency burst? :money_with_wings:

alex: Ops proposal: (1) Pre-warm 4 spare nodes in eu-west2 (warm-standby), (2) set autoscale min for the pool to 2 to keep headroom, (3) stage reboots one rack unit at a time with 10m gap between host reboots. I'll drop a short runbook snippet below.

alex: ```Runbook (short):
- mark hosts in eu-west3-gpu-pool-b as maintenance: rctl maintenance set --hosts host-0[1-8] --reason "PDU power handshake"
- pre-warm spares: infractl node spinup --region eu-west2 --count 4
- run LM probe: ./tools/check-lm.sh eu-west3-gpu-pool-b || mark host for graceful-drain
- staged power cycle: for h in host-01..host-08; do infractl drain $h --grace 120 && vendorctl pdu-cycle $h && wait 600; done
- monitor: console -> per-route latency + error-rate, escalate when 5xx spikes >2x baseline
```

maintenance-bot: Created ticket INFRA-1298 and scheduled maintenance in the ops planner.

dan: Action items: eva prepare full host->tenant mapping; mike post LM probe output by EOD; alex coordinate spare node prewarm and autoscale change; natalie confirm cost buffer; I'll draft Dedicated customer note. Ping sre-oncall immediately if we see sustained 5xx or connection resets. :thumbsup: 

eva: Sending host->tenant map to thread — also adding opt-out list for customers with hard SLAs.

mike: LM probe results: passed on 3/4 tested hosts. host-042 failed LM (needs driver update). Recommend excluding host-042 from automatic LM and performing manual reboot + kernel/driver patch after maintenance.

dan: Good catch. Exclude host-042 from the automation and treat as manual. Thanks everyone — will post the customer note draft in #customer-success in 30m.
